def _check_dependents(gpx_object: Any, fieldname: str) ->Tuple[str, str]:
    # Handle conditional metadata tag for GPX 1.0 vs 1.1
    if fieldname == 'metadata':
        # In GPX 1.0, metadata is not supported, so suppress it
        if hasattr(gpx_object, 'version') and gpx_object.version == '1.0':
            return 'metadata', '/metadata'
    
    # Handle bounds - only show when there are actual bounds
    if fieldname == 'bounds':
        if hasattr(gpx_object, 'bounds') and gpx_object.bounds is None:
            return 'bounds', '/bounds'
    
    # Handle conditional fields for GPX 1.1
    if fieldname == 'name' and hasattr(gpx_object, 'name'):
        # For GPX 1.1, name should be in metadata when it exists
        if hasattr(gpx_object, 'version') and gpx_object.version == '1.1':
            if hasattr(gpx_object, 'name') and gpx_object.name is not None:
                return '', 'name'
    
    # Default behavior - don't suppress anything
    return '', fieldname
